trap.label: there is little
trap.wrong: There is a little doubt that teams need skills.
trap.right: There is little doubt that teams need skills.
trap.why: Little (sem a) = quase nenhum; a little = um pouco. O brasileiro confunde porque português tem só “pouco”.

mcq.q: There is ___ doubt that teams need skills. (almost none)
I want to ___ my point across.

fix.wrong: There is a little doubt they will fail. (quase nenhuma)
fix.right: There is little doubt they will fail.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “There is almost no doubt that teams need skills.” (little)
rewrite.answer: There is little doubt that teams need skills.

rewrite.prompt: Use get across: “I explain my point clearly.”
Reescreva com no: “There is little doubt.” (use no)
